title: Principal Creative Director, AI Video
description: Who We Are Is What We Do. Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly. Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers. Why should you be part of our success story? As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are. Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google. Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work. About The Studio Deel is one of the fastest-growing companies in the world, and we're building the brand and creative studio to match. We make global campaigns, partnerships, film, design, and social at real scale, for businesses and for workers in almost every country there is. We're looking for someone exceptional to raise the bar on what we make. This is a hands-on role. You'd set the standard by making the work. The role Deel is a truly global, people-first brand, and it's taking off. We're looking for a creative director who works at the front edge of AI-native production across video and design. Most AI creative work is technically impressive and creatively empty. Some of it is good work that used AI somewhere in the pipeline. We think there's a real discipline in between, and we want you to build it here. You'd define how we make this work, and you'd prove it by making it. This is a hands-on role. What You'll Make AI-native creative. Work where generative tools are central to how it's made, at a standard the category hasn't reached. The stack. Our AI creative tooling and the workflows around it, including the principles for where we don't use it. Video and motion. Brand films, campaign work, and product storytelling that blend traditional and AI-led production. A repeatable method. Something the rest of the team can use, so the capability outlives any one project. What You Bring At least ten years across video, motion, or design, with direction as well as production. Recent work made or directed with generative AI that stands up as creative work first. Deep knowledge of the current tooling, and clear judgment about where it breaks. Proven ability to build a workflow other people can actually use. A point of view on likeness, disclosure, and provenance. We take these seriously. What Would Set You Apart A reel with range across live-action, motion, and generative work. Experience establishing an AI practice inside a creative team. A public point of view on AI in creative work. Who You'll Work With You'll sit inside the creative studio and work alongside our Creative Director, the video and motion teams, and the brand designers who'll build on what you establish. How We Work We're a studio, not a request queue. People here make things rather than manage from a distance. We use AI seriously, and we're deliberate about where we don't. Total Rewards Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all. Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission. Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion. Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location. We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it. You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page . Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email (recruiting@deel.com) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation. As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. title: Creative Director
description:
WHO WE ARE

Come join the company reinventing data security, empowering businesses to realize the full potential of their data. As the leading data security platform purpose-built for the cloud era, Cyera’s mission is to reinvent how businesses secure data, enable agile collaboration, and boldly pursue new business opportunities. Trusted by security teams at leading global businesses, our team is proving that data security is the next big thing in cyber. Backed by the world’s leading investors and working with a large and growing list of Fortune 1000 companies, we are looking for world-class talent to join us as we usher in the new era of data security.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re hiring a Creative Director to bring Cyera’s brand to life across every campaign and every touchpoint where a customer, prospect, or employee meets us. Reporting to the Head of Corporate Marketing, you will be a key strategic leader of Cyera’s brand and a core creative voice on the marketing leadership team.
This is not an execution-only role. We’re looking for a creative leader who pairs strong visual instincts with strong writing, and who treats every campaign as a chance to tell a story people remember. You’ll partner closely with Design Studio, Integrated Marketing, and other functions across marketing to make sure Cyera’s brand shows up with the same craft and clarity everywhere it appears, and you’ll lead a small creative team that you’ll be expected to grow, in capability and in ambition.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Brand storytelling across campaigns. Turn Cyera’s positioning and messaging into campaigns that fuse strong visuals with strong copy. Define and build briefs that serve as a guide to make every campaign feel like one idea, carried consistently across every channel and format.
Creative direction for key touchpoints. Set the creative bar for the moments that matter most: launches, events, the website, sales collateral, social, and executive communications. Make sure the brand feels like one brand, wherever someone meets it.
Partnership with Design Studio. Work hand in hand with Design Studio to turn creative concepts into finished work. Bring clear direction, sharp feedback, and a point of view that raises the level of what gets made.
Partnership with Integrated Marketing. Sit alongside Integrated Marketing from the start of campaign planning, so creative is built into strategy rather than added at the end. Help turn campaign briefs into ideas that earn attention.
Creative team leadership. Lead, coach, and grow a small creative team across Copy and Video. Model the craft, help your team members develop into stronger creative thinkers, and build the bench for Cyera’s next stage of growth.
Brand stewardship. Act as a guardian of Cyera’s voice and identity across the company. Give partners across marketing, sales, and product the creative guardrails they need to move fast without losing consistency.

QUALIFICATIONS

10-12 years of creative experience, including time as an art director, creative director, or similar role, ideally at a B2B technology company or a category-defining brand.
A portfolio that proves the partnership between visual and copy. You can point to campaigns where the idea, the design, and the words worked as one.
Enterprise brand experience. You know how to make a serious, technical brand feel human and memorable without losing credibility.
Hands-on craft. You can sketch a concept, sharpen a headline, or direct a shoot yourself, not just brief someone else to do it.
AI fluency. You know how to define where and how AI tools fit into the creative process, using them to raise quality and velocity together rather than trading one for the other.
Strong stakeholder management. You build trust with partners across marketing, sales, and product, and you know how to hold a creative point of view while navigating competing priorities.
People leadership. You’ve hired, coached, and grown creative talent, and people want to do their best work for you.
Collaborative range. You work well with design, marketing, and brand strategy partners, and you know how to hold a creative point of view without slowing a team down.
Operating principles that match ours, push boundaries, own and act, elevate together, and a leadership style that matches ours, model, coach, care.

COMPENSATION INFORMATION:

Compensation Range: $190,000-$230,000.

This compensation range represents Cyera’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Cyera may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. The final salary for this position will be determined in Cyera’s sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee’s work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Cyera’s business and other operational considerations.
Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements.
This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors.

BENEFITS - Why Cyera? 

Ability to work remotely, with office setup reimbursement
Competitive salary
Unlimited PTO
Paid holidays and sick time
Health, vision, and dental insurance
Life, short and long-term disability insurance
score_reason: Strong CD role with real creative scope, AI fluency expected, and solid pay, but US-only remote may limit hiring him as his location.

title: Group Creative Director
description: Who we are: MasterClass is the streaming platform where the world's best come together so anyone, anywhere, can access and be inspired by their knowledge and stories. We put you in the room with the creators, thinkers, makers, and leaders who have changed the world so you can change yours. Members get unprecedented access to 200+ instructors and classes across various fields, including Arts & Entertainment, Business, Design & Style, Leadership, Writing, and more. Step into Issa Rae’s writing session and Gordon Ramsay's kitchen. Go behind the big screen with James Cameron. Start your career with Martha Stewart. About the Role: As our Group Creative Director, you'll report to our Executive Creative Director and help lead creative direction across Class Launches, campaigns, and product launches. You'll be hands-on, producing and elevating work across copy, design, and art direction, not just directing others' execution. Your conceptual vision and creative judgment will shape how we communicate with our global audience, and as our team structure evolves, you'll grow into a formal leadership role guiding a team of copywriters, designers, animators, editors, photographers, and art directors. What You'll Do: Lead and Inspire: Guide the creative vision and strategy for creative campaigns, products, and marketing communications. Inspire your team to push the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Shape Our Voice: Write, define, and champion the tone and voice of marketing copy across various channels, ensuring consistency and authenticity. Delivering on-strategy, on-target, and on-brand messages and ensuring other writers are doing the same Stay Hands-On: Personally produce and shape copy, design, and creative work, not just direct it, across Class Launches, campaigns, and product marketing. Collaborate and Innovate: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including brand, performance marketing, enterprise, and product, to develop forward-thinking ideas and strategies. Mentor and Grow: Develop and mentor a team of copywriters, designers, and art directors, fostering a culture of creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Direct and Oversee: Provide creative direction and oversight across copy, art direction, design, video, animation, and other creative disciplines. Execute with Excellence : Deliver compelling, on-brand messages across all touchpoints, maintaining the highest quality standards and attention to detail. Adapt and Evolve: Stay ahead of industry trends and continuously seek new ways to tell our story in a rapidly changing landscape. What We're Looking For: Conceptual Visionary: Proven ability to develop original creative concepts that deliver real business impact. Sharp Creative Judgment: A track record of recognizing the strongest idea in the room and knowing how to push work further. Hands-On Maker: Comfortable personally producing copy and design work, not solely directing others, versatile across disciplines. Strategic Thinker: Able to translate strategic objectives into creative concepts that resonate, with an understanding of how creative connects to performance and conversion. Collaborative Partner: Experience working closely with cross-functional teams, including Performance Marketing, to drive integrated efforts. Visionary Leader: Proven experience leading creative teams across advertising, product, content, and creative strategy workstreams. Dynamite Storyteller: Exceptional writing skills with the ability to craft compelling narratives across various forms and mediums. Innovative Creator: A portfolio showcasing award-winning work and a knack for pushing creative boundaries. Qualifications: 10+ years of experience in creative roles, with a focus on producing standout work for global brands. Experience directing copy, art direction, design, video, animation, and other creative disciplines. Demonstrated expertise in conceptual and strategically-led campaign development. Experience in both agency and in-house environments. Ability to prioritize and work well under pressure while maintaining speed and high attention to detail given shifting timelines, updates, and last-minute changes. Should have a strong operational mindset and vision for the team. Ability to provide and receive constructive feedback across creative disciplines. Strong presentation skills and attention to detail; presenting work on behalf of the team, explaining the creative vision, strategy and approach. Experience developing and maintaining brand voice and tone guidelines. Experience and understanding of performance marketing and its integration with creative strategy. Proven ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Versatility in writing styles and tones, from short-form brand advertising & performance copy to longer-form editorial content. At MasterClass, we believe we put our best work forward when our employees bring together ideas that are diverse in thought. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. In addition, MasterClass will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.  If you have a disability or special need, we would like to know how we can better accommodate you. The salary range listed is for NYC/CA/WA. As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for any applicable geographic differential associated with the location where the position may be filled.MasterClass’s salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry. In addition to salary, we also offer equity and comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, flexible PTO, and more). The range listed is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate. Salary Range: $242,000 USD - $280,000 USD

title: Creative Director - Brand Narrative
description: In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront. Over the next nine minutes, Powers of Ten traveled out toward distant galaxies and back into the microscopic world inside a human hand. An enormous subject became a journey you could follow, built around a simple change in perspective. Images, language, movement, and sound brought the idea to life together. That’s the kind of creative thinking we’re looking for at Mercury: finding a compelling idea inside something complex, then bringing together the people and crafts that make it unforgettable. We’re looking for a Creative Director to build and lead Brand Narrative , a new team within Brand Creative. You’ll turn company strategy, product truths, customer insight, and cultural observations into original concepts for our most important launches, campaigns, and brand moments. You’ll originate ideas yourself and stay closely involved as they become finished work. Your background might be in art direction, design, or copywriting. What matters is your ability to develop exceptional concepts, recognize the best idea wherever it comes from, and bring the whole creative studio together to make it real. Whatever your starting discipline, you’ll bring deep experience in film-led storytelling. You’ll lead Brand Narrative in close creative partnership with your peers leading Brand Design and Writing. Together, you’ll shape concepts, language, and visual expression from the beginning, bringing distinct perspectives and shared ownership to the work. You’ll contribute strong ideas of your own, invite others to challenge and improve them, and build on theirs. This is a role for someone who enjoys making work together, not developing ideas in isolation and handing them off. You’ll also shape what Brand Narrative becomes. That means building its culture, developing its people, and establishing ways of working that make the entire studio more creatively ambitious. The opportunity is to make great work while building a team that can keep making it. Originate and lead big creative ideas. Partner with Product Marketing and Brand Marketing on the brief, then turn the agreed audience, opportunity, and product proof into original creative concepts. Develop ideas that can take distinctive forms across film, social, out-of-home, digital, experiences, and partnerships. Bring ambitious concepts to life with your creative peers and the full studio. Work side by side with the Brand Design and Writing leads and their teams from the earliest explorations through delivery. Develop ideas together, exchange thoughtful critique, and make creative choices that draw on each discipline’s expertise. Stay hands-on, contribute through your own craft, and partner closely with Motion and Production throughout. For film, remain closely involved through scripts, visual development, production, and the final edit. Build audience and distribution thinking into the idea. Shape concepts around how people will discover, watch, and share the work. Work with marketing partners to consider channels and viewing contexts from the beginning, so the work belongs where people encounter it rather than simply being resized to fit. Push beyond the first good answer, and learn quickly. Lead thoughtful concept development and critique. Use rough scripts, prototypes, and AI tools to test ideas quickly, learn, and move the strongest work forward. Know when to keep exploring and when to commit, then protect what makes an idea interesting through feedback and production. Find opportunities before a brief arrives. Bring curiosity about Mercury’s products, customers, and the wider world. Develop proactive ideas and cultural opportunities that give the brand something meaningful to say or do. Help decide where creative ambition matters most. Partner early with Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, Product Design, Comms, and Insights. Help identify which moments deserve our largest creative investment, present recommendations to senior leadership, and use results from marketing and insights partners to inform what comes next. Build and lead Brand Narrative. Define the team’s purpose, priorities, creative standards, and ways of working. Help hire and develop the team, shaping its structure and capabilities. Set clear expectations, and coach people to grow their judgment and conceptual strength. Create a culture where the best idea wins. Make room for experimentation, honest feedback, and contributions across disciplines. Lead with generosity and conviction, share ownership of the work, and help people challenge one another without making creativity a competition for credit. Build practices that strengthen the work. Establish a clear path from insight and an agreed brief to concept and execution, with useful critique and close collaboration throughout. Develop relationships with external creatives and agencies who can add a distinctive perspective or capability when needed. What you’ll bring A strong creative foundation in art direction, design, or copywriting. Your portfolio shows original concepts developed into ambitious, well-crafted work across multiple formats. You can explain what you contributed, how the idea evolved, and how collaboration made it better. Deep film experience. You’ve developed film-led ideas from concept through production, with strong instincts for story, scripts, performance, pacing, and sound. You understand how these choices work together to make an audience feel something, not just make a film look good. A track record of deep creative collaboration with design and writing peers. You’ve led ambitious multidisciplinary work from concept through production by building trusted partnerships. You bring a clear point of view, listen closely, work through creative disagreements constructively, and recognize when someone else’s approach makes the work stronger. title: Executive Creative Director
description:
Executive Creative Director

We’re looking for an Executive Creative Director who can lead both brand strategy and creative
direction.
The role starts with understanding what the client is actually trying to achieve. That means
asking the right questions, working through the context with stakeholders, and identifying the
real goal behind the brief.
From there, you’ll define the narrative and creative direction for the project. You’ll work with
the team to turn that direction into a strong brand system across identity, web, motion, and
product.
We’re looking for someone who is equally comfortable discussing business, strategy, and
creative work. You should be able to make clear decisions, explain the reasoning behind them,
and keep the work focused as the project develops.

About the Role
You’ll lead the strategic and creative direction of brand engagements from the first client
conversations through final delivery.
Early in the project, you’ll work with the client and our team to understand the business,
audience, market, and goals. You’ll help define the problem we need to solve and the position the
brand should take.
You’ll then set the narrative and creative direction and work with the design team to explore
several ways to bring it to life.
The role is not about managing a department. There is no responsibility for hiring or day-to-day
people management. Your focus will be the work itself: strategy, creative direction, client
communication, and the quality of the final result.
You’ll work closely with Ramotion’s designers, strategists, and project team. When a project
requires additional expertise, you may also help us identify the right people to bring in.

What You’ll Do
Lead discovery sessions and conversations with clients and stakeholders.
Identify the business goal behind the brief and define the strategic direction for the project.
Develop the brand narrative and creative direction.
Guide the team through two or three distinct creative routes and decide which ones are strong enough to take forward.
Make sure the direction works across identity, web, motion, and digital products.
Decide what work should be shown to the client and how it should be presented.
Lead client presentations and explain the thinking behind the work in a clear and convincing way.
Work through feedback with the client and the team. Know what should change and when it is important to push back.
Keep the work focused throughout the project and make sure the final execution still solves the
problem we set out to solve.

What We’re Looking For
8+ years of experience in branding, identity, brand strategy, or creative direction.
Significant experience working in branding agencies, design studios, or similar environments.
A portfolio with full rebranding projects, not only individual identity pieces or campaign work.
Evidence that you have led both the strategic thinking and the creative direction behind the work.
Strong knowledge of positioning, brand strategy, category thinking, and go-to-market considerations.
A strong understanding of visual identity, typography, illustration, web design, and digital
products.
Good creative judgment and the ability to explain why one direction is stronger than another.
Experience working directly with senior client stakeholders.
Confidence leading workshops and presentations in English.
The ability to work with small teams and adapt to different project constraints.
An active interest in new technology and AI tools, without losing sight of craft and original thinking.

Experience as a founder or partner of a small branding or design studio is a strong plus,
especially if you personally led both strategy and creative work.

What Usually Works Well in This Role
You’re comfortable getting into the details of a business and asking questions before jumping
into design.
You can move between a conversation about positioning and a detailed discussion about
typography, interface design, or motion without treating those as separate worlds.
You have a point of view, but you don’t rely on taste alone. You can explain your decisions and
make the case for the work.
You’re also comfortable working directly with clients. That includes difficult conversations,
conflicting opinions, and situations where the strongest creative answer may not be the easiest
one to sell.
And you stay involved. You don’t disappear after the strategy or the first presentation. You care
about how the work turns out.

How We Work
Ramotion is fully remote, and our team works across time zones.
This is a contract, project-based role. Compensation is agreed per project and includes the
opportunity for revenue-share upside.
We’re looking for someone we can work with repeatedly, not just for a single engagement. The
exact structure can be shaped together if the fit is right.

description:
Hussh is not entering categories. We are building them.

Category one: personal private agents. Private Agent One — a private agent for every person. It works only for its owner, earns for its owner, and moves only with its owner's consent. Your information belongs to you.

Category three — the new one, and the most disruptive: information as a subscription. Information as a service, offered by the owner of the information. Today, other people sell your information and keep the money. We are building the world where the owner sells it — as a subscription, with consent, at their price — and businesses subscribe to the person. Around these categories sit the products that carry them: Private Agent One, the Hussh money app, Puppy One, Hussh Shop, and the marketplace where owners and businesses meet directly.

None of these categories has a name the world uses yet. Giving them their names — and making the world repeat them — is this job.

You will work directly with the founder. There is no department to inherit, no playbook to run, and no committee to hide behind. There is a story the world has not heard yet, and it is yours to tell.

You have built a marketing function from nothing before. You have created a category, or carried one into the world. You write and think in few, exact words. You believe the product is the marketing.

Start by studying the work. Read hushh.ai end to end. Study our public code on GitHub. If the three categories pull at you, apply — and show us, in your application, the category you built and how you named it.

Every applicant is invited to join the Hussh network and claim their star — whether or not we work together, your information should work for you.

description: Image Studio Director Role Overview The Image Studio Director leads Assouline’s Image & Creative Studio, a central function within the Maison’s future Brand System. This role is both a visual leadership role and an operating role. It is responsible for codifying, protecting and evolving Assouline’s visual standards in close alignment with the Founders and VP Brand, while building the studio system required to deliver those standards consistently across brand-facing touchpoints: campaigns, product launches, collaborations, retail environments, wholesale tools, e-commerce, social platforms, editorial formats, events, partnerships and Maison moments. The Image Studio Director acts as the central owner of brand image direction, creative asset development, production standards, studio workflow and creative resource planning. The role must raise the creative standard without creating unnecessary bottlenecks, ensuring that visual excellence, speed of execution and team sustainability can work together. The role should protect Assouline’s codes while leaving room for cultural tension, surprise and unexpected creative expressions - a key dimension of the Maison’s ability to open new perspectives rather than simply repeat established formulas. PLEASE PROVIDE A PORTFOLIO WITH YOUR CV. Key Responsibilities Image Direction & Visual Standards Codify, maintain and evolve Assouline’s visual standards across brand, product, retail, wholesale, event, digital, social, editorial and partnership touchpoints. Translate the Founders’ creative, editorial and cultural vision into actionable visual principles, guidelines and execution standards. Ensure consistency across photography, art direction, typography, layout, motion, video, digital design, print applications, retail assets and event materials. Protect Assouline’s visual identity while ensuring the Maison continues to evolve, surprise and open new perspectives through image, composition, storytelling and cultural references. Define what “Assouline level” means across different formats, project tiers and channels. Studio Leadership & Creative Workflow Lead the Image & Creative Studio team across design, motion, production and coordination. Establish the studio as the internal center of excellence for brand image development, creative asset creation and visual execution. Implement clear intake, briefing, planning, review and delivery processes for creative requests. Ensure the studio is involved early enough in priority projects to shape visual ambition, not simply respond to downstream asset needs. Prioritize workload across internal teams and external creative partners, reducing duplication, late-stage pressure and fragmented feedback. Mentor and develop the team, raising creative judgment, executional discipline and cross-functional collaboration. Build a studio culture defined by high standards, clarity, accountability and calm execution under pressure. Brand Asset Strategy & Creative Development Define image strategy and asset needs for priority launches, campaigns, Maison moments, collaborations, events and special projects. Translate strategic briefs into visual territories, moodboards, shoot intentions, layout directions, asset families and production needs. Ensure major projects are supported by coherent asset ecosystems across hero visuals, social formats, e-commerce assets, press materials, event visuals, retail / trade tools and motion assets. Determine when existing book or editorial assets can be leveraged, adapted or extended for Brand purposes, and when new brand-specific assets need to be created. Ensure priority projects are not only visually consistent, but also capable of introducing a distinctive point of view, cultural tension or unexpected angle that reinforces Assouline’s role as a Maison that expands imagination. Challenge briefs when the requested execution does not match the level of ambition, audience, format or Maison standard required. Production Oversight, Photography & Image Rights Oversee brand-facing creative production in partnership with the Image Production Manager, ensuring shoots and content productions are planned with the right level of ambition, timing, budget and executional clarity. Supervise shoot briefs, production timelines, shot lists, contributor briefs, post-production workflows and delivery plans. Manage or oversee relationships with external photographers, videographers, art directors, set designers, retouchers, motion specialists, production partners and agencies. Clarify interfaces with existing photography and book production teams, particularly around asset repurposing, shared resources, shoot planning and handovers. Ensure image rights, usage terms, credits, licensing windows and asset availability are properly considered for brand, marketing, communications, e-commerce, retail, wholesale and editorial uses. Ensure final image selection, retouching, layout and adaptation meet Assouline’s standards. Budget, Resources & Team Management Oversee Image Studio resource planning, ensuring creative capacity is aligned with Maison priorities, project tiers and the Brand calendar. Partner with the VP Brand and relevant stakeholders to define production budgets, creative investment levels and external partner needs for priority projects. Track and manage image-related production costs, ensuring budgets are aligned with the ambition, visibility and strategic importance of each project. Identify resource gaps, bottlenecks and trade-offs early, and recommend the right balance between internal capabilities and external expertise. Build and maintain a strong external creative partner network across photography, art direction, video, styling, retouching, motion and production. Ensure the studio operates with the right balance of creative excellence, operational discipline and team sustainability. Governance & Cross-Functional Collaboration Clarify roles and responsibilities between Image Studio, Marketing, Communications, Events, Digital Brand, Commercial teams, existing photography teams and external creative partners. Establish clear review moments for major projects, including concept validation, asset plan validation, pre-production approval, image selection and final delivery. Partner with 360 Marketing, Communications, Events & Experiences and Digital Brand & Innovations to ensure image needs are anticipated and integrated into each project from the start. Contribute to post-project reviews, identifying what worked, what created friction, and what should be codified for future projects. Strong interest in books, culture, interiors, architecture, art, fashion, travel, design, hospitality and the world of collectors. Able to distinguish between projects that require exceptional creative ambition and projects that require efficient, elegant execution. Motivated by the opportunity to build a new internal studio function from the ground up.

title: Creative Director, Brand Visuals
description:
CREATIVE DIRECTOR, BRAND VISUALS 

**Note: We will be recruiting for this role internally and will not be entertaining 3rd party recruiters for this position.

5&2 Studios connects people around the world to stories from the Bible through uniquely human and authentic storytelling. Founded by Dallas Jenkins following the global success of The Chosen, 5&2 has expanded into producing both scripted and unscripted series, an animated series, and an expansive library of digital content. The independent studio also manages its own distribution,marketing, studio facilities, and consumer product line

Reporting to the Sr. Creative Director, Brand, the Creative Director, Brand Visuals leads the visual creative direction and expression of The Chosen and 5&2 Studios brands across campaigns, platforms, and audience experiences. This role turns broader brand and creative strategy into bold, cohesive visual systems and work that feels authentic, intimate, disruptive, and playful.

This person will set the visual approach for key campaigns and brand moments, guide work from concept through delivery, and ensure design and copy function as one integrated idea. This is a roll-up-your-sleeves role, combining equal amounts of hands-on design work and providing creative direction to a trusted network of freelance designers.
The Creative Director, Brand Visuals, will manage and develop freelance and contract design resources, and may guide internal designers as assigned. This person will establish clear briefs, match talent to the work, provide actionable direction, and maintain a consistent standard of craft across multiple projects. The Sr. Creative Director, Brand retains leadership of the broader integrated creative vision, cross-disciplinary strategy, and executive-level alignment.

This is a remote, full-time, exempt position with at least quarterly travel.

THIS MAY BE THE ROLE FOR YOU IF… 
You are a visual creative leader with a strong point of view and the ability to turn strategy into a clear, compelling creative direction.
You can align to the visual vision for a campaign, communicate it in a way that unlocks great work, and guide multiple creators toward one cohesive result.
You are still a maker at heart, willing to concept, design, or refine high-priority work when your hands-on contribution will materially strengthen the idea.
You know how to build and manage a flexible bench of freelancers and external partners, matching the right talent to each assignment and giving feedback that improves the work.
You bring exceptional taste across art direction, typography, imagery, composition, and visual systems, and you understand how those choices shape audience perception.
You are comfortable leading visual work across campaigns, digital, social, paid media, presentations, events, print, merchandise, and brand experiences.
You partner naturally with copywriters, marketers, strategists, producers, and project managers, so creative work is integrated from the beginning.
You care deeply about the mission of 5&2 Studios and want to create work that serves our audiences with authenticity, excellence, and care.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN
Visual Creative Direction 
Own the visual creative direction for assigned campaigns, launches, and brand moments, translating the Sr. Creative Director's broader vision and business objectives into a clear visual approach.
Develop and communicate visual concepts, campaign systems, mood boards, references, key art, and design direction that give internal teams and external partners a strong creative north star.
Guide work from initial concept through final delivery, making key visual decisions and ensuring the creative remains cohesive, intentional, and unmistakably 5&2.
Present visual concepts and creative rationale to cross-functional and senior stakeholders, building alignment while responding thoughtfully to feedback.

Hands-On Design and Creative Craft
Remain selectively hands-on, concepting, designing, or refining priority work where senior creative craft and judgment are most valuable.
Create or elevate high-impact deliverables such as key art, campaign concepts, visual systems, presentations, and flagship brand expressions.
Review work at meaningful creative milestones, focusing on concept, hierarchy, storytelling, brand alignment, and overall quality rather than owning every production detail.
Ensure visual ideas are executable across channels and formats without losing the strength of the original concept.

Freelance and External Creative Leadership
Build, maintain, and lead a strong network of freelance designers, art directors, illustrators, photographers, agencies, and production partners who can flex with the needs of the business.
Partner with Project Management to scope assignments, identify resource needs, select the right creative talent, and align on timelines, budgets, and deliverables.
Write and deliver clear visual briefs, onboard partners to the brand, establish expectations, and provide decisive, actionable feedback throughout the creative process.
Manage multiple external workstreams at once while protecting quality, consistency, accountability, and the experience of creative partners.

Brand Steward Evolution 
Serve as a visual steward of The Chosen and 5&2 Studios brands, protecting their distinct identities while adapting expression thoughtfully by audience, platform, market, and objective.
Partner with the Sr. Creative Director, Brand, to evolve visual standards, design systems, templates, and guidelines that strengthen consistency without limiting creativity.
Identify opportunities to modernize and expand the visual language while preserving the humanity, authenticity, and emotional connection at the heart of the audience relationship.
Help teams and partners understand not only what the brand standards are, but also how to apply them with good judgment.

Campaign Concepting and Integrated Collaboration
Partner with the Sr. Creative Director, Brand, Associate Creative Director, Copy, marketers, and strategists to translate campaign objectives, audience insights, and brand stories into compelling integrated concepts.
Lead visual thinking in brainstorms and campaign development, bringing strong ideas that can extend across channels and audience touchpoints.
Ensure copy and design are developed together as one cohesive creative idea rather than as separate workstreams.
Collaborate closely with Brand, Marketing, Social, Content, Consumer Products & Experiences, Music, International, Events, and other teams to develop thoughtful visual solutions.

Creative Operations and Continuous Improvement 
Partner with Creative Project Management to clarify scope, prioritize work, surface dependencies, and establish review points that keep creative moving efficiently.
Help improve briefing, review, asset organization, templates, and workflows so internal teams and external partners can produce stronger work with greater consistency.
Stay attuned to emerging design practices, cultural trends, audience behavior, and creative technologies, bringing relevant fresh thinking to the team.
Use evolving creative tools thoughtfully to improve ideation and execution while maintaining human judgment, originality, and brand integrity.

WHAT YOU BRING: 
10+ years of progressive experience in visual design, art direction, brand creative, or creative direction, ideally within entertainment, media, consumer brands, or an agency environment.
A strong portfolio demonstrating high-level creative direction, exceptional visual craft, integrated campaign development, brand systems, and storytelling across multiple formats.
Demonstrated experience setting visual direction for campaigns and guiding work from concept through final execution.
Experience building, briefing, directing, and managing freelancers, agencies, and external creative partners across multiple concurrent projects.
The ability to remain selectively hands-on in design while leading and scaling execution through others.
Deep understanding of brand systems and the judgment to maintain consistency while evolving visual expression by audience, channel, and objective.
Experience partnering closely with copywriters, strategists, marketers, project managers, producers, and senior stakeholders.
The ability to interpret creative briefs, translate strategy into compelling visual direction, and articulate the rationale behind creative decisions.
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud and fluency with the tools and workflows used to develop and review professional creative work.
A strong understanding of AI tools and emerging design technology, and the ability to quickly ideate, iterate, & compose ideas and visual direction.
Experience creating work for faith-based, mission-driven, or values-led organizations is strongly preferred.
The ability to approach faith-based stories, themes, and imagery with cultural awareness, curiosity, and respect.
Passion for the mission of 5&2 Studios and a Fan First mindset.

THE EXTRAS YOU DESERVE:
Unlimited Time Off & 12 Paid Holidays.
Company-Paid Health, Dental & Vision: Comprehensive coverage for you and your dependents; The Chosen covers approx. 85% of monthly health costs.
401(k) with up to 6% Company Match.
Paid New Child Leave for new moms and dads.
Employer-Paid Life, LTD, & STD Insurance.
Merchandise Discounts for You & Your Family.
Wellness Perks to keep you happy and healthy.
Travel Opportunities: internal activations like theatrical premieres, ChosenCon, our annual staff retreat, and opportunities to help on set and see The Chosen being produced in real-time.
The latest tech from Apple to make sure your at-home setup is top-notch.

These extras are our way of saying, "Welcome to the team, we're thrilled to have you!"

We will be accepting applications for this role until October 23rd, 2026.

title: Creative Director
description:
Location: This position is remote within the United States.

The role.

We’re looking for a Creative Director of Marketing to help shape how Huge shows up in the world. For more than 25 years, Huge has made things people love. Now, as a human-first, AI-native design and technology company, we make things that matter. You’ll bring our category-defining work to life in the market: bold campaigns, big conceptual moments and assets that make a CMO, CDO or CEO stop mid-scroll and pay attention.

This role sits where brand and demand meet. Brand makes buyers know us and want us before a sales conversation starts. Demand gets them to act. You’ll build the creative that does both, and carry people from curious to convinced. You’ll combine strong conceptual thinking with exceptional craft and the ability to take work from initial idea to production-ready execution. You’ll do this in a fast-paced environment with a global team (Toronto, London, New York), where a flexible, proactive attitude is essential to keeping the work moving and making the most of each opportunity. You’ll be powered by the most advanced AI tools and our own operating system, Huge OS, built to give creative leaders speed, range and room to push the work.

This role reports to the Managing Director of Marketing and works closely with our Chief Creative Officer and our visual and brand design leaders. Marketing communications sits inside the growth organization with business development, alliances and outbound. It’s one connected team building the brand and driving growth together. You’ll have an ops lead, copywriter and content lead working collaboratively with you so you are supported across all key functions.

What you’ll do.

Lead the creative expression of Huge’s positioning across all core channels.
Bring the big ideas and campaign platforms that give the brand a differentiated point of view to drive brand and performance KPIs.
Day-to-day hands-on creative leadership and execution, from first concept through production-ready files with marketing, comms and creative teams.
Develop campaign concepts and conceptual moments that bring Huge’s positioning to life in market.
Create organic social content for LinkedIn and Instagram.
Develop digital advertising for LinkedIn and partner display formats.
Design website content, including imagery, diagrams and data visualisation for thought-leadership articles.
Develop and apply a cohesive design system for podcast content.
Design emails and supporting campaign assets.
Create supporting materials for award submissions.
Concept and design employee merchandise, delivering production-ready assets.
Shape our presence at events through creative concepts, graphics and branded experiences.
Partner with alliances, growth and vertical leads to build co-branded and partner-facing creative that still feels like Huge.

What we'd like to see.

Eight or more years in art direction, brand design and campaign development at an agency, consultancy or leading brand, including time leading creative work or other creatives.
A strong portfolio demonstrating conceptual thinking, visual craft and delivery across multiple formats.
Fluency using AI tools in creative workflows, with a clear view on where they help and where they flatten the work.
Experience taking work from concept through to final production.
English fluency.

Huge’s Brand Has Recently Been Refreshed, And We’re Still Defining How It Comes To Life In The World. This Is a Unique Opportunity To Become a Custodian Of The Brand, Helping Shape Its Expression And Ensuring We Show Up At Our Best. This Means We'd Like To See 

Conceptual ambition. You lead with ideas and push the creative possibilities. We want someone whose ambition we occasionally need to rein in, whose ideas arrive with conviction.
Brand and campaign experience. You understand how to build a recognisable brand while keeping its expression fresh across channels.
A consumer-first perspective. You draw inspiration from the best B2C brands and are curious about applying that creativity, relevance and emotional appeal to B2B.
Strong visual craft. You bring confident typography, composition, imagery, motion and attention to detail. You love the little details as much as the big ideas. 
A multifaceted skillset. You’re comfortable working across digital, print and physical formats, adapting your approach to each.
Independent drive. You’re a self-starter who can organise their work and move it forward. You don’t sit back and wait for answers.
A collaborative mindset. You listen carefully, respond thoughtfully to feedback and confidently put your ideas forward.
Practical curiosity. You enjoy figuring out how things work and finding creative solutions to constraints.
Competitive Edge:
Motion design and animation skills, especially for social content, digital advertising and brand storytelling.
Experience in B2B, professional services or technology marketing.
Experience designing events, environments or other physical brand experiences.
Previous roles in agency or consultancy brand and marketing teams supporting similar work.
About Huge.

Huge is an independent, human-first AI-native design and technology company. We make things that matter by bringing AI, people, design and technology together as one system. With more than 1,000 design and technology experts working in hub cities around the world, including Bogotá, Chicago, Ho Chi Minh City, London, Los Angeles, Medellín, New York, San Francisco, and Washington, DC, we partner with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, including Google, NBCU, PepsiCo, Vail Resorts, Atlantic Health, and Candescent. Huge is committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability, or if you’re parenting the next generation of innovators, we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

The Creative Director leads creative strategy, brand identity, and creative operations for High Profile's marketing organization. Creative Strategy & Brand Stewardship

Set the creative throughline for each initiative: the core idea, tone, visual direction, and example executions, as inspiration for channel directors to build strategies against.

• Bring an external point of view on creative quality, benchmarking High Profile's output against strong work in retail, CPG, and adjacent categories, and raising the team's overall craft bar.

Channel Expertise & Growth Channels
• Define a high quality standard for High Profile's paid advertising creative across digital and traditional media, including display, paid social, video, direct mail, and out-of-home. Produce to that standard across all operating states and their compliance rules.
• Own creative direction and content quality for paid digital and organic social, partnering with the Digital team, which owns channel strategy, targeting, and media spend, to ensure content performs and reflects brand standards.
• Lead creative concepting for campaign and initiative-level work, including seasonal campaigns, brand initiatives, and new channel launches.
• Lead the Design Manager on creative direction for traditional media, maintaining quality and consistency in High Profile's highest-spend traditional channels.

Creative Operations & Systems
• Own and rethink High Profile's highest-volume recurring production processes, beginning with the weekly promotional workflow, identifying opportunities to reduce manual production time through AI-assisted tools and improved systems.
• Evaluate and implement AI and workflow tools across the creative team to increase throughput and creative capacity without adding headcount.

Team Leadership
• Provide strategic direction, workload prioritization, and professional development to the creative and design team.
• Build a scalable, well-documented creative operating model that teaches frameworks for creative thinking, brief writing, and critique.
• Report on creative team performance, capacity, and initiative progress to the VP of Marketing. Owns creative & design budget and manages to target.
• Builds productive working relationships within marketing and with cross-functional partners: buying & planning, retail, compliance, wholesale, and facilities.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Leads a team of four: Design Manager, Production Packaging Designer, Senior Graphic Designer, and Graphic Designer. This role directly manages the Design Manager, Sr. Graphic Designer, and Graphic Designer. Creative Director will also direct external paid media agencies.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:
• 6+ years in creative roles, with at least 3 years as a Creative Director, Associate Creative Director, or equivalent.
• 3+ years at an integrated, full-service, or brand agency in a concept-leading role (copywriter, Design Manager, ACD, or CD), creating campaign ideas rather than only producing assets.

• Portfolio with integrated work from concept through execution across three or more channels.
• Portfolio evidence of distinctive paid media creative across digital and traditional channels.
• Strong, current point of view on social-native content, ideally with experience connecting content quality to measurable performance.
• Experience building or improving creative production systems and workflows, familiarity with AI-assisted workflows strongly preferred.
• Experience managing a creative or design team of 3+ people.
• Experience leading brainstorms or concept development with cross-functional partners who don't report to them, with examples of ideas others built out across channels.
• Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and bringing proactive recommendations to leadership.
• Cannabis or other regulated industry experience a plus, but not required.

description: DIRECTOR, BRAND Function: Marketing (Brand) Reports to: Senior Director, Product Marketing & Brand The Company OnBoard builds the software that boards of directors run on — the AI-forward platform for preparing, running, and following up on the meetings where organizations make their biggest decisions. The Opportunity We are expanding our markets, into segments held by the biggest names in the space. We are David walking into a field of Goliaths — and we like our odds, because we are coming in with momentum, a product buyers get excited about, and a level of innovation incumbents can't match. Brand is how we press that advantage. The mandate for this role is to expand our presence and grow the perception of OnBoard as the place to be for board management — the solution directors recommend to the boards they join and the boards their peers sit on. In a market where buyers trust the people sitting next to them at the table, peer perception is a growth engine, and Brand's job is to earn and amplify it. The buyer journey itself is changing, too. More of it now runs through AI layers — buyers ask an LLM about their options before they ever visit a website. We see Brand as having a vital place in that new journey: human recommendations and perception matter as much as what the models say about us and who we're for, and this role shapes both. The Role The Director of Brand reports to the Senior Director of Product Marketing & Brand and owns brand strategy, narrative, and creative expression for both OnBoard and eScribe. You will shape what the brands stand for and how they show up in-market, then drive that expression across our channels. At its core, the role demands a strategist and a storyteller — someone who thinks a few steps ahead, someone who spots the seed of a great story and turns it into differentiated narratives for the brand. You are accountable for measurable brand outcomes: awareness, engagement, share of voice, and thought leadership reach that support the company's expansion into new markets. Key Outcomes This is what success looks like. How you get there is largely up to you — that's why we're hiring a director. Everyone speaks the same language, we look like one company, and the market responds. You will shape a brand strategy, story, and visual and verbal identity for OnBoard and eScribe that creates excitement and alignment. The real test is external: the market responds and starts mimicking our language back to us. The markets we're expanding into know who we are before we ever call them. As we enter new segments, awareness, credibility, and preference with those buyers become key for brand to own. You will figure out how the company earns that — through research into how these buyers discover and judge vendors, and through the strategies and tactical programs that put us out in front. Directors bring us with them. The strongest signal a brand in this market can earn is a director telling a fellow board, "you should be on OnBoard." You will build the perception and the peer-to-peer presence that make OnBoard the platform directors recommend to the boards they join and the boards their peers sit on. Our executives are voices the industry follows. Our leaders have stories worth hearing. Your team will shape that — building their presence on LinkedIn and beyond, and extending it through webinars, video, bylines, and stages, with audience growth you can point to. We show up in the coverage — and the AI answers — that shape buyer perception. Because more of the buyer journey now runs through AI layers, you will partner with our SEO and GEO team to evaluate and iterate what LLMs say about our brand and who we’re for — so when a buyer asks an LLM about board management, not only do we show up, the right brand narrative appears, too. The stories worth telling get found, and get told everywhere. Customer outcomes, product moments, research, market shifts — the raw material is all around us. You will own Brand's content strategy inside the marketing team's shared roadmap and turn that raw material into narratives that carry across channels and formats. The work Brand takes on is the work worth doing. You own intake, prioritization, and the brand budget. That means pressure-testing requests against goals, outcomes, and tradeoffs — and having the judgment and the standing to reshape or decline work that won't return value. Results get reported in business terms, and the team gets better every quarter. You work with your leaders to establish KPIs and baselines, and show up in leadership forums with a clear point of view and numbers behind it. And you will coach your people through clear goals, honest feedback, and stretch assignments. Who You Are You are a storyteller before you are anything else. You spot the seed of a great story in a customer call, a product release, or a stray data point, pick up threads from across the business, and weave them into narratives that work in a keynote, a LinkedIn post, and a press pitch. This goes well beyond strong writing — it is the talent this role is built around. You can't imagine working without AI anymore. You use AI-led workflows for brand and content work every day, you are comfortable inside an AI-first production system, and you get genuinely excited about what agentic workflows make possible for a brand team. You have taken a brand into new markets and can tell us exactly what changed. You have built brand presence that helped a B2B company expand — into new segments, new buyers, or new categories — and you can walk us through the before, the after, and what you would do differently. You have made executives into voices people follow. You have grown leaders' platforms on LinkedIn or similar channels and can show the audience and engagement curves to prove it. You think in content strategy not just content calendars. You have set content direction across teams and tied it to business outcomes, and you understand how AI-driven discovery (GEO) is rewriting the rules of being found. You say no when needed and with grace. Brand and Content teams face a constant list of “what if we did this” requests. You pressure-test requests against goals, risks, and tradeoffs, and you decline or reshape work that won't return value — without burning the relationship. You are an energizer. You bring pace and optimism to a fast-moving, PE-backed environment where brand has to show its contribution to growth — and you make people want to work with your team. title: Creative Director
description:
At BioRender, we’re on a mission to accelerate the world’s ability to learn, discover, and communicate science — transforming how knowledge is shared and making science open, collaborative, and easily understandable by all.

We’re shaping the future of science communication and are looking for talented individuals to help bring this vision to life! 🚀

About The Role

As Creative Director at BioRender, you’ll bring our mission to life by defining and evolving how BioRender shows up across every marketing touchpoint. You’ll own BioRender’s brand identity, creative vision, and design function—leading the development of world-class creative that strengthens our brand, tells compelling stories, and helps scientists better understand the value of our platform.

This is a hands-on, high-impact leadership role where you’ll collaborate closely with Marketing, Product, Executive Leadership, and Design teams to translate strategy into beautiful, effective creative. You'll set the creative direction while remaining closely connected to the work, building a brand that inspires millions of scientists around the world.

What You’ll Be Doing

Define and evolve BioRender’s brand identity, visual language, and creative strategy—ensuring a consistent, compelling, and recognizable brand across every customer touchpoint.
Lead the creative vision and execution across product marketing, integrated campaigns, website, social media, video, motion graphics, events, sales enablement, and other marketing initiatives.
Partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Leadership to translate business objectives, product strategy, and brand positioning into impactful creative that drives awareness, engagement, and growth.
Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing creative team while fostering a culture of creativity, craftsmanship, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Develop and maintain scalable brand guidelines, design systems, and creative asset libraries that enable consistency and efficiency across the organization.
Establish creative processes, workflows, and resource planning that allow the team to execute high-quality work quickly and effectively.
Stay ahead of design, branding, storytelling, and visual communication trends—bringing fresh ideas and creative ambition to everything BioRender puts into the world.

What You Bring To The Table

8+ years of experience in creative, brand, or design leadership, with at least 3 years leading high-performing creative teams in a fast-paced SaaS, technology, healthcare, or life sciences environment.
Experience with or a strong understanding of medical illustration, scientific visualization, or scientific design, and an appreciation for communicating complex science through thoughtful, visually compelling creative.
Proven success developing and scaling world-class brands, leading integrated marketing creative, and delivering exceptional creative work across digital, print, video, and experiential channels.
A strong portfolio demonstrating outstanding brand leadership, visual storytelling, and high-quality creative execution across multiple marketing channels.
Experience creating marketing creative for scientific, healthcare, biotech, pharmaceutical, or other highly technical audiences, with the ability to simplify complex concepts through compelling visual communication.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities, with a knack for building strong relationships across Marketing, Product, Executive Leadership, and cross-functional teams.
A passion for building brands that educate, inspire, and help scientists communicate their discoveries more effectively.
A growth mindset — you're curious, creative, resourceful, and excited to shape one of the world's most beloved brands in science communication.

Why join us?

We are mission-driven: we work collaboratively towards our shared vision of improving scientific communication and accelerating scientific discovery. BioRender figures have appeared in more than 54,000 publications!
BioRender is loved by millions: We have a world-class NPS and a community of loyal fans and users in 200+ countries!
Our company is backed by top investors and accelerators like Y Combinator, and we are on a growth trajectory comparable to many top-performing SaaS companies
We’re remote-first with team members across Canada and the U.S., offering you the flexibility to work from anywhere.

BioRender is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. By submitting this application, you consent to the processing of your personal data by BioRender in accordance with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 39,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

Your Mission

Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in-product moments, and beyond.

You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high-performing, on-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.

This is a role for a creative leader who wants to build as much as they lead shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.

What You'll Own

• The AI-assisted creative engine. Design the end-to-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. • The bridge between brand and scale. Work closely with Engine's Brand team to translate creative and narrative into Engine's brand systems while finding new ways to scale performance without losing what makes the brand distinctive.
• In-person and experiential creative. Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.
• Brand-distinctive, entertainment-first work. Ship creative that earns its media spend: bold, memorable, and unmistakably Engine. Bring flagship ideas that break category conventions while keeping the creative pipeline fresh ahead of fatigue.
• Testing velocity. Partner with Growth on structured testing frameworks, concept logs, and learning agendas so every cycle compounds into smarter, stronger creative.
• The creative team. Lead and develop designers, editors, AI specialists, and producers. Set the creative bar, stay close to the work, and deploy your own craft when it counts. Build a culture that values experimentation, speed, accountability, and exceptional creative standards.

How We'll Measure Success

Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in-person moments.

Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.

What You'll Bring

• Extensive experience in creative strategy or creative leadership, with a track record of innovation and measurable business impact.

• Hands-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.
• Strong direct-response instincts: you can diagnose hooks, understand why creative performs, and know what makes work effective platform by platform.
• A systems-builder mindset. You naturally think in workflows, SOPs, pipelines, and ways to increase creative velocity without compromising quality.
• Craft pedigree in copy, art direction, design, or video that grounds your strategic judgment.
• Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.
• Experience leading and developing creative talent while remaining close enough to the work to contribute directly when needed.
• Visionary and pragmatic, with high agency and an appetite for building in a fast-moving, AI-forward environment.

We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.

Compensation

Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
